lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: Two contacts entering the passage. Same glow, same fives.

lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: They're talking to each other. Can we not let them finish the conversation?

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: Hold still. Let them come to us. Moss, the charges?

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Cold, quiet and very rude. Ready when they are.
